g.title: J_OBC_RF
g.text: Samtec TFM-108 right-angle (was FTSH-108), SFSDT socket

OBC board J2 at (+41.0, -33.5), below RF J1: PD5, PD6, PE3, PE4, PA0, PC0, PC1; inputs TONE_OK PC9, XPDR_KEY PG12, PTT_EXCITER PC7 (capture), RX_CD PG0, RX_FAULT PF13, each 10 k series and 100 k pull-down (SQSO-ICX-001 B 3.2)

g.title: W4A
g.text: Samtec SFSDT discrete-wire assembly, PTFE, 30 AWG

3.3 V logic both ends (RF side 3.1 V CMOS, 1 k series on the readbacks). Monitors 0-2.5 V into ADC1. TX_PWR_SEL low 0.5 W, high 1 W. XPDR_EN: 100 Hz heartbeat, 100 k pull-down on the RF board. RX_CD, RX_FAULT active high, 100 k pull-downs. Flat (two layers, 5.3 x 1.3 mm) on the +X shear panel at y -28.5 to -38.5

g.title: J_RF_OBC
g.text: Samtec TFM-108 right-angle (was FTSH-108), SFSDT socket

g.title: J_EPS_RF
g.text: Pico-Clasp 501330-0600, gold terminals (EPS J19 as Pico-Clasp 6, was Micro-Fit 2x3)
EPS J19, bottom side, zone Z2: SW2 RADIO, SW3 PA outputs

g.title: W4B
g.text: M22759/33-28. RADIO 3.3 V: 89 mA keyed (SW2 limit 0.14 A); PA 5 V: 0.469 A at 1 W on two wires (0.235 A each, SW3 limit 1.07 A: 0.54 A per wire, 60 % of 0.90 A derated); 36 mV at 1 W. Twisted pairs 3+2, 4+5, 1+6, at most 5 mm untwisted at each end (0.7 nT at magnetometer A2)
